content.short: World Liberty Financial runs the USD1 stablecoin, lending markets, cross-chain bridging and the WLFI governance token.
content.description: World Liberty Financial is built around USD1, a dollar stablecoin issued on several chains. WLFI Markets, built with Dolomite, lets users supply and borrow assets, and a bridge moves USD1 and WLFI between networks. WLFI holders govern the platform. For AI use cases, the AgentPay SDK lets agents hold funds and pay across chains within set per-transaction, daily and weekly limits. WLFI holders can stake to earn rewards in USD1 and must vote on governance proposals to claim them, and the token became tradable after a community vote.
